description: Utility class for image resizing functions, providing methods to resize images with or without maintaining aspect ratio, and with different quality hints.

classes.name: ProductImageSizeUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for image resizing operations.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes an image to specified width and height without maintaining aspect ratio.

methods.name: resizeWithHint
methods.description: Resizes an image to target dimensions with specified interpolation hint and optional higher quality multi-step scaling.

methods.name: resizeWithRatio
methods.description: Resizes an image while maintaining aspect ratio based on destination width and height, with optional fallback to original dimensions if zero is specified.
